style: Close-up realistic food photograph: the dish fills almost the entire frame, shot slightly from above at a 30-45 degree angle, served on tableware that suits the dish. Plain, softly blurred neutral background with no furniture, windows, table edges, cutlery or napkins. Soft natural light, true-to-life colours and portion size, appetizing home cooking, not over-styled. No text, no labels, no logos, no people, no hands.

dishes.spaghetti-bolognese: Spaghetti bolognese: a nest of spaghetti topped with a rich slow-cooked minced beef and tomato sauce with small pieces of carrot, finished with freshly grated parmesan, in a wide shallow pasta bowl.
dishes.kylling-i-karry: Danish 'kylling i karry': mild creamy yellow curry with chunks of chicken breast, onion and strips of red bell pepper, served over fluffy white rice, in a deep ceramic bowl.
dishes.ovnlaks-kartofler: Oven-baked salmon fillet with lemon slices, crispy roasted potato wedges, steamed broccoli florets and a small bowl of dill crème fraîche, on a flat dinner plate.
dishes.tacos: Friday tacos: two soft flour tortillas filled with spiced minced beef, shredded lettuce, diced tomato, cucumber, sweetcorn, grated cheese and a dollop of crème fraîche, on a flat plate.
dishes.frikadeller: Classic Danish frikadeller (pan-fried pork and veal meatballs, golden brown) with boiled new potatoes and a small bowl of thinly sliced cucumber salad in vinegar, on a flat dinner plate.
dishes.stegt-flaesk: Danish stegt flæsk med persillesovs: crispy fried pork belly slices, boiled potatoes and a creamy white parsley sauce full of chopped green parsley, on a flat dinner plate.
dishes.koteletter-i-fad: Pork chops baked in a dish with a creamy paprika and mushroom sauce, served with white rice, in a small oven dish.
dishes.polsegryde: Danish pølsegryde: sliced sausages with onion and red bell pepper in a creamy tomato sauce, served over white rice, in a deep bowl.
dishes.medister-spidskaal: Danish medisterpølse (pan-fried coiled pork sausage) with boiled potatoes and creamy stewed pointed cabbage (stuvet spidskål), on a flat dinner plate.
dishes.kyllingelaar-ovn: Roasted chicken legs with crispy golden skin on a sheet of roasted potatoes, carrots, red onion wedges and whole garlic cloves with thyme, in a small roasting tin.
dishes.kylling-wok: Chicken and noodle stir-fry with strips of chicken breast, mixed wok vegetables, ginger, garlic and soy, topped with sliced spring onions, in a deep bowl.
dishes.thai-karry: Thai red curry with chicken, coconut milk, red bell pepper and courgette, garnished with fresh coriander and a lime wedge, with a side of jasmine rice, in a deep bowl.
dishes.torsk-persillesmor: Pan-fried white cod fillet with lemon and herb butter, boiled potatoes and green beans, on a flat dinner plate.
dishes.fiskepinde: Crispy breaded fish fingers with golden oven potato wedges, green peas and a lemon wedge, a child-friendly dinner, on a flat dinner plate.
dishes.laks-teriyaki: Salmon teriyaki: pan-seared salmon fillet with a glossy sweet soy glaze, sprinkled with spring onion, steamed broccoli and white rice, on a flat plate.
dishes.lasagne: A generous square portion of homemade beef lasagne with visible layers of meat sauce, pasta sheets and béchamel and a golden bubbly cheese top, on a flat plate.
dishes.chili-sin-carne: Vegetarian chili sin carne with kidney beans, black beans, sweetcorn and bell pepper in a thick smoky tomato sauce, with rice and a dollop of crème fraîche, in a deep bowl.
dishes.chili-con-carne: Chili con carne with minced beef, kidney beans and bell pepper in a thick spicy tomato sauce, served with rice and a dollop of crème fraîche, in a deep bowl.
dishes.carbonara: Pasta carbonara: spaghetti in a silky egg and parmesan sauce with crispy bacon pieces and plenty of black pepper, in a wide shallow pasta bowl.
dishes.pesto-kylling-pasta: Pasta with green basil pesto, sliced pan-fried chicken breast, halved cherry tomatoes and baby spinach, finished with parmesan shavings, in a wide shallow pasta bowl.
dishes.kikaertecurry: Chickpea curry with spinach in a creamy coconut tomato sauce, served with white rice, in a deep bowl.
dishes.linse-dahl: Red lentil dahl, smooth and golden orange, with coconut, a lime wedge and fresh coriander, served with rice, in a deep bowl.
dishes.frittata: Oven-baked frittata with sliced potatoes, spinach and crumbled feta, cut into wedges, with a small green salad on the side, in a cast-iron pan.
dishes.hjemmelavet-pizza: Homemade thin-crust pizza with tomato sauce, melted mozzarella, sliced mushrooms and red bell pepper, on a wooden pizza board.
dishes.burgere: Homemade beef burger in a glossy brioche bun with lettuce, tomato and red onion, with homemade oven fries on the side, on a flat plate.
dishes.kylling-pita: Warm pita breads filled with spiced chicken strips, lettuce, tomato, cucumber and tzatziki, on a flat plate.
dishes.morbradgryde: Danish mørbradgryde: medallions of pork tenderloin in a creamy paprika and mushroom sauce, served with white rice, in a deep plate.
dishes.hel-kylling: A whole roast chicken with crispy golden skin, stuffed with lemon and garlic, surrounded by roasted potatoes, in a roasting tin.
dishes.stroganoff: Beef stroganoff: strips of beef with mushrooms and onion in a creamy paprika sauce, served over white rice, in a deep plate.
dishes.kylling-bowl: Chicken rice bowl with sliced chicken breast, white rice, avocado slices, diced cucumber, sweetcorn and spring onion with a lime wedge, in a wide bowl.
dishes.tun-pasta: Pasta with tuna in a simple tomato sauce with onion and garlic, sprinkled with chopped parsley, in a wide shallow pasta bowl.
dishes.sod-sur-kodboller: Small pork meatballs in a glossy sweet and sour sauce with red and yellow bell pepper and onion, served with white rice, in a deep bowl.
dishes.kyllingefrikadeller: Golden pan-fried chicken patties (kyllingefrikadeller) with oven-roasted potato wedges and a bowl of tzatziki with cucumber, on a flat dinner plate.
dishes.sode-kartofler-feta: Oven-roasted sweet potato cubes with crispy chickpeas, crumbled feta, baby spinach and thin red onion rings, with a dollop of yoghurt, in a wide shallow bowl.
dishes.champignonrisotto: Creamy mushroom risotto topped with golden roasted mushrooms and parmesan, in a wide shallow bowl.
